identity: Deterministic projection of the retained admission evidence: the line leaf shapes the executed original serializer receipt (toolkit-cli/research/fixtures/dali-ext-proxy-original-vectors.json, case all_line_families) covers and whose dirty write the native exclusions leave effective. Not an original-runtime capture; byte ownership is each leaf's serializer source mapping, including overlapping ObjectProperties byte-4/5/6 flags and excluding family-reserved bytes (object byte 7 and bytes 10..31, each sceneTriggerMap slot's reserved byte 19). rust/cbus-cgate/src/service/dali_proxy.rs emits these rows inside CMQTT CAPABILITIES dali_session_extended_proxy.writable_line_fields; the dali_proxy_lines unit tests bind the enumeration to this vector and to the receipt, and test_dali_line_capability_admission.py binds the CLI's evidence table to these rows.
